static_traits.name: Lin Jie西
static_traits.educational_background: Having taken cooking classes while growing up
static_traits.social_status: Recently distant from friends and family, tends toward self-isolation
static_traits.medical_history: without重要躯体疾病;without既往心理治疗或心理问题史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,配合度高,能进行自我Reflection;但频繁use负性标签与绝对化表述(如'I am a failure'),Low mood,语速平稳

basic_info.main_problem: 最近not yet通过烹饪节目试镜后,持续感到自己是'失败者',not断反刍该次失败;每当想到试镜或看到与烹饪相关内容即感到自卑与not足,Decreased motivation并出现Social avoidance,日常烹饪习惯被打乱.
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定来做咨询,因为我注意到这种失败感正在影响我继续追求成为Chef这一梦想的动力.
growth_experiences: 成长过程中接受系统的烹饪课程,逐步培养了对烹饪的热爱与专业志向,长期以来一直以成为Chef为目标.
此前not yet经历过类似的失败或重大挫折,也never接受心理治疗,这使得此次试镜失败成为少有的强烈负性体验,缺乏应对失败的经验.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough / incompetent

special_situations.event: The announcement of the cooking show audition result (not passed)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能在关键场合一次性成功,就证明我not适合当Chef,I am just a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 自我苛责,停下平常的练习与尝试,Avoids socializing以避免被评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am just a failure,我可能not适合当Chef

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 任何与烹饪相关的线索都会提醒我这次失败,并证明I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 减少做饭,以看电视等方式Distraction回避not适线索
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这又证明我not行/我永远赶not上

special_situations.event: 回想试镜时评委的反馈(包含正向评价但整体not yet通过)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有'通过/成功'才算数,任何正向反馈都not算真正的能力证明
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Actively ignores and devalues positive information to maintain the consistency of the self-label
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那些表扬have not意义,not通过就说明我完全not行

special_situations.event: Friends or family try to contact, or thinking about meeting them
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他们知道I failed,就会看not起我或失望
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids contact with relatives and friends, choosing self-isolation to avoid embarrassment and judgment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am awful

core_conflict.wish: 渴望通过成就被认可,证明自己作为Chef的价值并被肯定
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败意味着自己一without是处,会被他人negate和羞辱,梦想破灭
defense_goal: Maintains control and drives change through self-harshness
与他人保持距离以减少负面评价带来的羞耻与Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: not够好,可能被淘汰的失败者
object_relations.object_representation: Critical, judgmental others (such as judges, surrounding people)

object_relations.self_representation: not配与人接触,需要隐藏失败的一方
object_relations.object_representation: 会失望或看not起自己的他人(朋友/家人)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others point out her strengths in auditions / positive feedback received
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向将他人的肯定视为客套或not算数(移情地将他人体验成'并not真正认可我'的客体)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和而具体化,邀请举证与细化情境,先Empathy其羞耻与失落,再温柔整合正负证据,避免对抗式反驳.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about failure and being invited to discuss next-step plans or contact people
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将潜在对外的愤怒/失落转为自责,认为自己not配,not该表达需求
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 先验证与命名自我批评带来的痛感,use温柔的反映与重述帮助外化'苛责的内在声音',鼓励以第一人称表达需要并尝试小而可行的行动.

manifestations: After failing an audition, actively distances from friends and family, finding it hard to share feelings of failure with supportive friends
outcomes: 支持系统利用not足,Recovery速度减慢

manifestations: 在挫折后对是否适合成为Chef产生怀疑,Decreased drive,对既往热爱的烹饪失去兴趣
outcomes: Confusion and wavering about his career path and sense of self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Evaluates himself with rigid rules such as 'I must/should succeed' (equating success with self-worth)
将'not yet通过=have not价值'作为绝对标准

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 频繁自责与负性自我贴标签('I am a failure')
Worries about others' evaluations and withdraws expression, hard to share experiences with supportive friends

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: 用看电视等Distraction方式回避失败后的羞耻与without力感
在被邀请关注积极证据时迅速转回'还not够好'的叙事

exception_events.target_problem: 在面对与烹饪相关的高压情境(如试镜,线上烹饪内容)时,来访者通常会涌现Self-deprecation与失败标签,并随后回避练习与社交,Decreased drive.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在试镜当天,尽管紧张,仍能投入烹饪并完成作品,且有评委肯定其菜品风味,这与'完全失败/一without是处'的主导故事有所偏离.
exception_events.reason: 线索:当下专注于烹饪过程(not同做法),对烹饪的热爱与长期训练基础(not同资源),以及现场获得即时的正向反馈(not同支持),共同促成了当场的投入与部分积极结果.

positive_force: His love of cooking and the training foundation accumulated while growing up
Ability to still complete work under high-pressure scenes and gain some positive feedback
愿意求助并尝试以更平衡的方式看待挫折(自我Reflection能力)
negative_force: A way of thinking with catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and self-labeling
negate正向信息,只关注失败的心理过滤
Social avoidance and self-isolation,削弱支持系统
Rigidly binds success and failure to self-worth (a 'must succeed' rule)

target_behavior.function: 短期内逃避羞耻与Anxiety,维持对情境的主观控制感
target_behavior.consequence: 烹饪练习与日常作息中断,职业Decreased motivation,Low mood与without力感加重

antecedent: Friends or family reaching out / inviting proactively
Thinking one might be evaluated or asked about audition results
